title: Chili con carne
recipe:
1. Dice [the onions](#0) and finely chop [the garlic](#1). Heat [the oil](#17) in a sauté pan and brown [the beef mince](#2) with [the spices](#3,4,5,6,7) and [salt](#18), if desired, for 5–6 minutes over medium-high to high heat. Brown [the meat](#2) well by cooking it a little longer on one side and pressing it down lightly from time to time. [The meat](#2) does not need to be evenly cooked through. The browner pieces add more flavor.
2. Clean [the red peppers](#8) and cut them into pieces of about 1 cm.
3. Add [the onion](#0) and [red pepper](#8) and cook for 3 minutes over medium-high heat. Add [the garlic](#1) and cook for another 2 minutes, stirring regularly.
4. Meanwhile, put [all the beans](#9,10) in a colander and rinse them under cold running water. Drain well.
5. Add [the tomatoes](#11), [chipotle pepper](#12), and [water](#13), then crumble [the stock cube](#14) over the mixture. Break [the tomatoes](#11) into pieces with a wooden spoon. Add [the beans](#9,10), [chocolate](#15), and [sugar](#16), bring to a boil, then cover and simmer over low heat for 90 minutes. Stir occasionally. Season with [black pepper](#19) and [salt](#18), if desired.

## To serve
1. Serve with toppings of your choice, such as [sour cream](#20), [grated cheddar](#21), [chili rings](#22), [jalapeño rings](#23), [coriander](#24), [lime](#25), [finely chopped tomatoes](#26), and [red onion](#27).

ingredients.name: red pepper
ingredients.preparation: cleaned and cut into 1 cm pieces
